plan.title: docs: issue pipeline, end to end
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Docs-only change: one new page, its docs.json nav entry, and one-line cross-links in six existing pages across features/, configuration/, cli/ and the repo root. The 'subsystems' are Mintlify doc directories, not code subsystems. The cross-links are meaningless without the page and the page is unfindable without them, so splitting into sibling issues would ship orphaned or broken docs. Items that edit the page are serialized by blocks edges.

narratives.Problem: No user page explains how an issue moves through Overdeck from pan start to a closed issue. The facts are spread over developer docs, role prompts and stale user pages, several of which contradict current code (the test agent, the server rebase, Pipeline page groups).
narratives.Proposal: Add features/issue-pipeline.mdx, built section by section from the verified facts and anchors in .pan/drafts/PAN-5468.md: pipeline at a glance, Start an issue, Plan, Work and pan done, Verification, Review, Tests and UAT (checkpoint on #5537), Feedback the work agent receives, Needs you and pan ask, Merge, Strikes, After merge: close-out, pan show and the pipeline journal, Restart/rerun/reopen, Get help. Put it first in the Features nav, add one link line to six related pages, and record clean Mintlify checks in the PR body.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No changes under src/, scripts/, tests/, packages/, apps/ or roles/; no changelog.d entry
- No fix for #5537 (test role not dispatched after review)
- No rewrite of features/specialists.mdx, concepts.mdx, introduction.mdx or other pages beyond the one-line links (owned by #5502, #5499, #5505)
- No cli/pipeline-commands.mdx and no link to it (#5478)
- No close-out settings documentation (#5479)
- No screenshots
- Never run mint validate --fix

autoDecisions.summary: Page path features/issue-pipeline.mdx, title 'Issue pipeline: from issue to merged PR', first in the Features nav before features/planning
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names the path, the example title and 'put it first in Features'; #5469's comment asks to keep issue-pipeline first and planning right after it.

autoDecisions.summary: Document the test role as it behaves today and filed #5537 instead of fixing it
autoDecisions.rationale: Nothing emits review.approved, so the test role never starts after review; none of the last 12 merged PRs has a test or UAT verdict. The issue requires claims to match code and is docs-only, so the page states current behavior behind an implementation checkpoint that switches wording if #5537 lands first.

autoDecisions.summary: Code wins over --help text for pan reopen, pan strike and pan start --force
autoDecisions.rationale: reopen resets no specialist state (it is derived), strikes auto-merge after one quick review (v0.86.0), and --force clears the operator-decision gate only with --fresh; the issue says every claim must match current code.

autoDecisions.summary: Review is documented as quick by default with the convoy in full mode
autoDecisions.rationale: roles.review.mode defaults to 'quick' in src/lib/config-yaml/roles.ts; the issue's phrase 'review convoy' is covered by linking /features/convoys for full mode.
The images/dashboard set dates from June 2026 and shows the old brand; the issue forbids inventing UI. Sibling PAN-5474 made the same call.

autoDecisions.summary: One-line cross-links in six pages; stale claims there are reported, not fixed
autoDecisions.rationale: #5502, #5499 and #5505 own the accuracy audits of specialists, concepts and introduction; comments with the findings were posted on #5502 and #5499 to avoid conflicting rewrites.

autoDecisions.summary: No link to cli/pipeline-commands and no close-out settings docs
autoDecisions.rationale: #5478 creates the CLI page and #5479 owns close-out settings; linking a missing page would fail broken-links.

autoDecisions.summary: Pin mint@4.3.49 and never run mint validate --fix
autoDecisions.rationale: Sibling docs issues standardized on that version; --fix rewrites about 80 files other issues edit in parallel.
